en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a busy European town square filled with market stalls, carts, and people. Surrounding the square are richly ornamented gabled brick houses and civic buildings in Dutch Renaissance style. Dominating the background is a tall church tower with an ornate multi‑tiered spire, while in the right-middle stands a smaller stepped‑gabled building fronting the square. The perspective is from an upper-floor balcony looking over the square. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Some faint handwriting or printed caption appears at the very bottom but is largely illegible.
